title: Adaptive confabulation resolves the persistence paradox for individuals and lineages

fields.label: Label
fields.value: Adaptive confabulation resolves the persistence paradox for individuals and lineages

fields.label: Statement
fields.value: Levin argues that the paradox that a changing agent or species ceases to be itself while an unchanging one dies out is resolved by continuous commitment to creative, adaptive confabulation (reinterpretation of memories and information) at levels from molecular to behavioural, in individuals and whole lineages.

fields.label: Work
fields.value: Self-Improvising Memory: A Perspective on Memories as Agential, Dynamically Reinterpreting Cognitive Glue

fields.label: Chapter
fields.value: Levin M 2024, Self-Improvising Memory: A Perspective on Memories as Agential, Dynamically Reinterpreting Cognitive Glue › Abstract

fields.label: Quotation
fields.value: Continuous commitment to creative, adaptive confabulation, from the molecular to the behavioral levels, is the answer to the persistence paradox as it applies to individuals and whole lineages.

fields.label: Assumptions
fields.value: Levin M, “Self-Improvising Memory: A Perspective on Memories as Agential, Dynamically Reinterpreting Cognitive Glue”, Entropy (Basel, Switzerland) (2024), doi:10.3390/e26060481; section “Abstract”. Scope: Individual organisms and evolutionary lineages

fields.label: Assessment
fields.value: GPT-5.6 Sol on levin-2024-memory-02: not-empirically-resolvable, resolvability 0.10

fields.label: Finding
fields.value: Evidence of memory reinterpretation would illustrate the proposal but would not decide whether an individual or lineage remains the same entity. Plausible outcomes can be redescribed consistently with either position.

fields.label: Proposed test in the assessment
fields.value: Proposed test with existing data: No observation uniquely establishes that adaptive confabulation resolves the philosophical identity paradox, because persistence and identity lack an independent measurable criterion in this formulation.

fields.label: Evidence against
fields.value:
The persistence paradox is conceptual.

Creative confabulation has no scale-independent operational definition.

fields.label: Finding
fields.value: This is a conceptual answer to a paradox about what makes an individual or a lineage persist. Molecular, developmental, and phylogenetic records describe change, but they do not contain a result that would confirm or refute confabulation as the resolution. The claim has no empirical decision criterion.

fields.label: Proposed test in the assessment
fields.value: Proposed test with existing data: The persistence paradox is a philosophical tension about identity through change. No biological variable distinguishes continuous adaptive confabulation as its resolution from other accounts of development and lineage continuity.

fields.label: Evidence against
fields.value:
Identity through change is not a measured variable.

Any observed physiological change can be narrated as confabulation or as ordinary turnover.
